lines: Burst generator: while a gate is held it fires bursts spaced by a randomised time and sends each one to one of eight step outputs
The voltage the step CV outputs carry; every channel of a polyphonic cable is passed on
Bursts are fired only while the voltage here is above 0V; taking it low stops them and clears the timer
Steps through the three burst modes in turn; the lit lamp shows whether single, multi or seq is in force
Sets the base time between bursts, 0 to 10 seconds
Sets how far each gap strays from the base time, 0% to 100%; at 50% a gap falls anywhere between half and one and a half times the base
Sets this step's weight, 0 to 1: in single mode the chance the burst picks this step, in multi the chance it fires on its own, in seq the chance the burst moves on to it; at 0 the step is never used
Switches this step's CV output between holding the voltage taken when its burst arrived and passing the CV input through for as long as the step fires
Carries the CV input for this step: with sh off it follows the input while the step fires and drops to 0V otherwise, with sh on it holds the voltage taken at the last burst
10V while the burst is on this step, 0V otherwise
Note — no burst is fired until the gate input is taken above 0V, and a step whose weight knob is at 0 is never chosen.
Note — when the gate input goes low the step the module stopped on keeps its gate output at 10V until a later burst moves off it.

lines: Quantizer, sequencer and negative-harmony generator laid out on the circle of fifths, with a button for each of the twelve intervals
The voltage to be quantised in quant + sh and neg harmony modes; in sequencer mode its level sets the direction instead, 0V or above running forward and below 0V running backward
In quant + sh and neg harmony modes a rising edge takes a fresh sample of the cv input and holds it until the next edge; in sequencer mode it is the clock that advances the sequence
A rising edge sends the sequence back to its first note, and does nothing in the other two modes
Sets the root the intervals are measured from, as a 1V/octave pitch; in quant + sh and neg harmony modes only the fraction of a volt is used
Steps through the three modes in turn; the lit lamp shows whether quant + sh, sequencer or neg harmony is in force
Puts the root itself into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the fifth into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the major second into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the major sixth into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the major third into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the major seventh into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the tritone into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the minor second into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the minor sixth into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the minor third into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the minor seventh into the set of notes the module uses
Puts the fourth into the set of notes the module uses
The quantised or sequenced note as a 1V/octave pitch
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the note at the cv out changes
Menu — Quant + SH — quantises the cv input to the notes switched on around the circle, sampling it on a trigger when one is patched
Menu — Sequencer — steps around the notes switched on around the circle, clocked from the tg in jack, and keeps the note within one octave of the root
Menu — Negative harmony — quantises the cv input and then returns the note mirrored about the axis between the root and the fifth
Menu — Load Scale: Ionian/Major, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian/Minor, Locrian, Harmonic Minor, Whole Tone, Major Pentatonic, Minor Pentatonic, Blues Scale — loads that scale
Note — with no interval button switched on the module puts out the root and nothing else.
Note — the quantizer splits each octave evenly between however many intervals are switched on, so every one of them gets the same share of the incoming voltage rather than the share nearest to it.
Note — sequencer mode is monophonic; the other two modes follow the larger of the cv in and tg in channel counts.
